arm_hand_roles.left: Sole manipulating hand: surrounds and grips the bottle body, lifts from the blue plate, transports and lowers onto the turquoise plate, and opens to release.
arm_hand_roles.right: Open idle hand, with minor repositioning above the pink-plate side. Does not grasp, support, stabilize, or receive the bottle.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: One-hand transfer between plates; no hand-to-hand transfer, two-hand support, person interaction, or locomotion is visible.

uncertainties: The exact instant of bottle-base contact is partly occluded by the left hand; the subsequent upright bottle on the plate and visibly opened hand establish placement and release.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
